_note: Deploy-side manifest for the Drama Studio mini-app. No real Cloudflare id, token or secret value belongs in this file: the wrangler config keeps <PLACEHOLDER> ids and deploy.sh resolves them into a throwaway /tmp config at deploy time. U2 owns worker/ (service), U3 owns pages/ (UI); this manifest and deploy.sh own deploy/ only.

env.token_var_note: The DEPLOY token: account/zone resolution, the zone guard, R2, the secret puts and the Worker deploy. Read from the environment only; no value belongs in this file.
env.kv_dns_token_note: OPTIONAL. Covers the KV-namespace and the DNS steps (they need KV namespaces read/write and zone DNS records read/write, which the deploy token may not carry). Unset or empty it FALLS BACK to env.token_var. Names and HTTP codes are printed; values never are.
